decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter has stayed on the website for two years and fits the firm's growing organic line, so its results appear to meet aspirations and give no reason to search for alternatives.

The premium salami snack was extended with Classic and poultry variants, which signals satisfactory performance in a growing industry, though its move from its own page to a mention adds some uncertainty.

The organic boiled pork sausage is a recent launch on its own page, and a hiring firm with slack in a growing industry would carry it while its results are still uncertain, in line with its organic expansion strategy.
The organic thin-sliced chicken breast, launched in two flavours, supports the organic and ingredient-conscious direction, and slack allows the firm to give it time to prove itself.
The organic herb-coated salami is a new product close to the firm's core salami competence with low marginal cost, so the firm keeps it while it builds results against its aspirations.
